import math

def calculate_and_factor(n):
    # Calculate a_n = 6^n + 2^n + 3^n - 1
    a_n = 6**n + 2**n + 3**n - 1
    
    # Factorize a_n
    factors = factorint(a_n)
    
    return a_n, factors

def solve_task():
    # Set of all primes encountered so far
    all_primes = set()
    # List to store new primes encountered for each n
    new_primes_log = {}
    
    print("--- Sequence Calculation and Factorization (n=1 to 20) ---")
    
    for n in range(1, 21):
        a_n, factors = calculate_and_factor(n)
        
        # Get the unique prime factors for this a_n
        current_primes = set(factors.keys())
        
        # Identify new primes
        new_primes = current_primes - all_primes
        
        # Update the global set of all encountered primes
        all_primes.update(current_primes)
        
        new_primes_log[n] = new_primes
        
        print(f"\n--- n = {n} ---")

        print(f"Prime Factorization: {factors}")
        
        if new_primes:
            print(f"NEW PRIMES ENCOUNTERED at n={n}: {sorted(list(new_primes))}")
        else:
            print("No new primes encountered.")
            
    print("\n--- SUMMARY OF ALL NEW PRIMES ENCOUNTERED ---")
    all_new_primes = set()
    for n, primes in new_primes_log.items():
        all_new_primes.update(primes)
